race.description: Tab Stayers Lounge Gong Race Day Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: GLASTONBURY GIRL (4) talented mare who found the 1200m too sharp first up with a sound third over 1200m at Gosford in this company. Key jockey change and has a good record second up. POWDER MAN (5) trained locally and Rawiller takes the reins from the low gate. Motored late with a tidy second over 1350m at Wyong. Expect to see him a touch closer to the speed and figure prominently. BEVERLY HILLS (11) win record hardly excites but looks to get the right set-up for this. Expect J Mac to give her every chance from the inside marble after she boxed on to secure second at Beaumont (Newcastle) over 1350m. Top four contender. SATNESS (1) will find this easier with the 3kg claim after he failed to close off when fifth in a Midway BM72 over 1400m at Randwick. Can find the front from the awkward draw and figure in the finish.
